title: Preview: Aston Villa v Sunderland, who has the edge?
body:
Aston Villa host Sunderland in the Premier League on 2026-11-21 [F1]. The Touchline Takes Analyst model gives Aston Villa a 52% chance of winning, the draw 29% and Sunderland 19% [M1]. In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Aston Villa have 2 wins, 3 draws and 0 defeats from their last 5 league games: 9 points, 10 scored and 8 conceded [ST1].

In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Sunderland have 1 win, 1 draw and 3 defeats from their last 5 league games: 4 points, 2 scored and 7 conceded [ST2]. The last meeting in our Football-Data.co.uk results, on 2026-04-19, finished Aston Villa 4-3 Sunderland [ST3]. The latest from BBC Sport: “Four 'huge mistakes' that show Man Utd's defensive problems” [S1].

Form matters, but big games have a habit of ignoring the spreadsheet. This is the kind of fixture where one moment of quality settles everything. The Touchline Take: back Aston Villa [M1], but do not be shocked if this gets messy.
